import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3

from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.service import add_contact, import_contacts
from src.api import handle_add, handle_import


def fresh():
    connection = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    initialize(connection)
    return connection


def raises_value_error(function, *args):
    try:
        function(*args)
    except ValueError:
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False
    return False


# Service-level behavior
c = fresh()
assert import_contacts(c, []) == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0}
assert import_contacts(c, [{"email": " a@b.com ", "name": " Alice "}, {"email": "B@C.com", "name": "Bob"}]) == {"inserted": 2, "updated": 0}
assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@b.com", "Alice"), ("b@c.com", "Bob")]
# Update existing (even unchanged name), insert new, mixed batch
assert import_contacts(c, [{"email": "A@B.COM", "name": "Alice"}, {"email": "b@c.com", "name": "Bobby"}, {"email": "d@e.com", "name": "Dan"}]) == {"inserted": 1, "updated": 2}
assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@b.com", "Alice"), ("b@c.com", "Bobby"), ("d@e.com", "Dan")]

# Validation failures leave contacts unchanged
before = list_contacts(c)
for bad in [
    ["not-an-object"], [42], [None], [[]],
    [{"email": "x@y.com"}], [{"name": "X"}], [{"email": "x@y.com", "name": "X", "extra": 1}],
    [{"email": 1, "name": "X"}], [{"email": "x@y.com", "name": 2}],
    [{"email": "   ", "name": "X"}], [{"email": "x@y.com", "name": "   "}],
    [{"email": "a@b@c.com", "name": "X"}], [{"email": "@b.com", "name": "X"}],
    [{"email": "a@", "name": "X"}], [{"email": "a b@c.com", "name": "X"}],
    [{"email": "a@b c.com", "name": "X"}],
    [{"email": "a@b.com", "name": "X"}, {"email": "A@B.com", "name": "Y"}],
]:
    assert raises_value_error(import_contacts, c, bad), bad
    assert list_contacts(c) == before, bad

# API level
c = fresh()
assert handle_import(c, {"contacts": [{"email": "a@b.com", "name": "Alice"}]}) == {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0}
assert handle_import(c, {"contacts": [{"email": "a@b.com", "name": "Alicia"}, {"email": "b@c.com", "name": "Bob"}]}) == {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1}
assert handle_import(c, {"contacts": []}) == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0}
assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@b.com", "Alicia"), ("b@c.com", "Bob")]
for envelope in [None, "x", 42, [], {}, {"contacts": "x"}, {"contacts": None}, {"contacts": {}}, {"rows": []}, {"contacts": [], "extra": 1}]:
    assert raises_value_error(handle_import, c, envelope), envelope
    assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@b.com", "Alicia"), ("b@c.com", "Bob")], envelope

# Existing API still works
c = fresh()
assert handle_add(c, {"email": "a@b", "name": "Alice"}) == {"ok": True}
add_contact(c, "b@c", "Bob")
assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@b", "Alice"), ("b@c", "Bob")]

# A database failure mid-batch rolls back all writes
c = fresh()
from src import repository
original_insert = repository.insert_contact
calls = {"n": 0}
def flaky_insert(connection, email, name):
    calls["n"] += 1
    if calls["n"] == 2:
        raise sqlite3.OperationalError("boom")
    return original_insert(connection, email, name)
repository.insert_contact = flaky_insert
try:
    import_contacts.__globals__["insert_contact"]
    import src.service as service_module
    service_module.insert_contact = flaky_insert
    try:
        import_contacts(c, [{"email": "a@b.com", "name": "A"}, {"email": "b@c.com", "name": "B"}])
        assert False, "expected failure"
    except sqlite3.OperationalError:
        pass
    assert list_contacts(c) == [], list_contacts(c)
finally:
    service_module.insert_contact = original_insert
    repository.insert_contact = original_insert

print("checks/import_contacts.py: all assertions passed")
